items.title: Mrs. Arnold Metoyer Interview, 1960-10-19
items.q: Well, my husband intended to make a musician out of her oldest son

ctx.x: Maybe another musician, famous musician, come out of the family sometimes.

Well, my husband intended to make a musician out of her oldest son, but he didn't live long ago. He said, I'm going to make a musician out of him. I'll connect the out of him. I tried it. I had him for a year, but he suffered with high blood pressure when he was just 12 years old, and the doctor told me it wouldn't be very good for him. So I just dropped the blowing.
